profiles.purpose: Mass-generate high-value positive, negative, property and regression tests.
profiles.prompt: Inspect the bounded source and propose tests that can genuinely fail. Deduplicate against the current suite and rank by defect-catching value.
profiles.objective_gate: New tests fail on seeded defects and pass on the accepted implementation.
profiles.cadence: after material code changes and during idle capacity
profiles.risk: test volume without mutation strength creates false confidence

profiles.purpose: Search for reproducible defects and failure modes.
profiles.prompt: Generate independent bug hypotheses, then supply the smallest deterministic reproducer for each.
profiles.objective_gate: A clean checkout reproduces the defect or the finding is rejected.

profiles.purpose: Find debt that has measurable reliability, cost or maintenance impact.
profiles.prompt: Identify debt with exact source evidence, downstream consequence and a bounded remediation.
profiles.objective_gate: Static evidence plus a before/after metric or removed failure path.

profiles.prompt: Produce independent minimal refactors that preserve public behaviour and reduce a named cost.
profiles.objective_gate: Existing tests, locked behaviour fixtures and a named structural metric pass.
profiles.cadence: only after a measured debt finding

profiles.purpose: Document existing code from inspected evidence.
profiles.prompt: Explain entrypoints, state, dependencies, failure paths and operational procedures with source anchors.
profiles.objective_gate: Every material claim resolves to a current source anchor and documented commands execute.

profiles.purpose: Investigate large codebases and answer bounded architecture questions.
profiles.prompt: Trace the requested behaviour from entrypoint through state and external effects; distinguish extracted facts from inference.
profiles.objective_gate: Source paths and executable probes support the trace.

profiles.prompt: Extract components, owners, calls, data flows and trust boundaries; mark ambiguous relationships.
profiles.objective_gate: AST/config evidence validates structural edges; semantic edges retain confidence and sources.

profiles.purpose: Use independent models to review a candidate change.
profiles.prompt: Review only actionable correctness, reliability, compatibility and evidence defects; cite exact locations.
profiles.objective_gate: Findings reproduce, fail a test, or are rejected.

profiles.purpose: Generate security hypotheses for authorised code only.
profiles.prompt: Inspect trust boundaries, untrusted inputs, secrets, privileges and dependency exposure; propose safe local verification.
profiles.objective_gate: Authorised deterministic reproduction or static proof; no live exploitation.

profiles.purpose: Check dependencies, locks, build files and runtime configuration.
profiles.prompt: Find drift, unsupported versions, missing locks, unsafe defaults and configuration contradictions.
profiles.objective_gate: Package-manager/config validators and current primary documentation confirm findings.

profiles.purpose: Generate many genuinely independent implementations or hypotheses.
profiles.prompt: Use the assigned approach and do not imitate prior candidates. Return a complete bounded candidate.
profiles.objective_gate: The same objective suite scores every alternative; best is selected by evidence.

profiles.purpose: Periodically re-audit older code against current tests and standards.
profiles.prompt: Recheck the bounded legacy surface, prioritising changed dependencies, prior incidents and untested paths.
profiles.objective_gate: New evidence is compared with the prior audit; unchanged noise is suppressed.

profiles.purpose: Spend cheap inference to prepare a compact evidence packet for an expensive model.
profiles.prompt: Consolidate attempts, tests, failures, disagreements, source anchors and unresolved decisions without restarting analysis.
profiles.objective_gate: Packet hashes all referenced artifacts and stays within its context budget.
profiles.cadence: only when cheap ensemble cannot pass the gate
profiles.risk: context bloat or majority error presented as fact

profiles.purpose: Measure each model and ensemble on real project tasks.
profiles.prompt: Solve the locked task without access to hidden expected results.
profiles.objective_gate: Project-specific tests score success, repair cost, latency, tokens, cost and false claims.

profiles.purpose: Measure how far orchestration, memory, tools, tests and retries lift a mediocre model.
profiles.prompt: Run locked tasks under single-shot, repair-loop, ensemble and ensemble-plus-memory conditions.
profiles.objective_gate: Compare held-out pass rate, false-success rate, repair attempts, latency, tokens and cost.
profiles.cadence: monthly and on material engine changes
profiles.risk: changing several variables without controlled ablations

profiles.purpose: Test whether a free-model ensemble replaces one frontier call for a workload class.
profiles.prompt: Run the same hidden benchmark through the cheap ensemble and the frontier baseline.
profiles.objective_gate: Use identical locked evaluators and report quality, false claims, wall time and total cost.
profiles.risk: judge bias, data leakage or comparing different context

profiles.purpose: Estimate the optimal number of cheap attempts versus one expensive attempt.
profiles.prompt: Sweep independent-candidate and repair budgets on locked tasks using deterministic stopping rules.
profiles.objective_gate: Produce a Pareto frontier over success, repair cost, latency, tokens and monetary cost.

profiles.purpose: Use a future stronger model to redesign the inference fabric from accumulated evidence.
profiles.prompt: Review benchmark history, incidents, current contracts and unresolved tradeoffs; propose a versioned architecture candidate.
profiles.objective_gate: Independent review, migration plan, backwards-compatible contracts and benchmark improvement are required before adoption.
profiles.cadence: when a materially stronger model becomes available
profiles.risk: prestige-driven rewrite that discards proven mechanisms

profiles.purpose: Use temporary preview/free capacity before expiry.
profiles.prompt: Run the highest-value queued benchmark or audit compatible with this model's capabilities.
profiles.objective_gate: Every request maps to a queued workload and stores useful evidence; no quota-burning loops.
profiles.cadence: while a verified free window is active
